description: Live check of the version 5 rules (Builderr's feedback on the latest run: live job openings only, profiles for this exact company, more dated news from the company's own site) on the registered websites of the same 1,000-company sample (examples/smoke-1000.txt). The 45 registered websites that version 4 already leaves out (group, chain, manager, parked and similar sites), or that block outside scripts, were not re-run.
how_it_was_run: As for version 4: agent/website.ts, agent/web.ts and agent/orgnr.ts were downloaded from GitHub at the tested commit, checked by SHA-256 and run in a browser tab on each company's own site, with the company's identity from Enhetsregisteret. The agent's own functions decided the website, the social accounts, the dated news posts and the job ads. robots.txt was honoured.

social.why_some_were_left_out: A handle with an extra place or other word (fodoslo, evask_stavanger, InventuraBergenOslo, advhelleland), a bare-brand account for a unit whose legal name carries a place word (Personaltjenester for Personaltjenester Telemark AS), or a brand account on a site that names another company carrying the brand (treteam: Treteam AS; floyaoffisiell: Fløya Anlegg AS). These rules favour leaving out an account that may be right over publishing a parent's.

Product feeds and product items are now left out, and prices written as '199 kr' count as prices (commit 0d7090f).
